# PR #101 — Add `difficulty` filter to `GET /search`

**Status:** Merged
**Labels:** `enhancement`, `needs-docs`
**Author:** @eng-mkowalski

---

## What changed

`GET /search` now accepts a `difficulty` parameter. Optional, filters trips by
their difficulty rating.

Matching is case-insensitive. Omitting the parameter returns trips of every
difficulty, as before.

## Why

Most support requests about route selection are really about difficulty. The
field was already on the trip object; this exposes it as a filter.

## Diff summary

```
mock-api/server.py
+ "difficulty" added to allowed search parameters
+ filter applied when the parameter is present
```
